recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數顆嗜中性球，胞質內含一大團均質、沒有染色質紋路的淡紫色圓形物質（LE body），把分葉核擠到邊緣呈新月形；這就是典型的 LE 細胞（LE cell）。
features: Neutrophils containing a large, round, smooth, homogeneous pale purple intracytoplasmic mass (LE body)
Host neutrophil nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery, often crescent-shaped
Inclusion lacks chromatin texture, nucleoli or nuclear membrane detail, indicating denatured opsonized nuclear material
Background hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic predominance across maturation stages and scattered erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a myeloid predominance showing orderly maturation. Scattered neutrophils contain large, round, homogeneous, structureless pale purple intracytoplasmic bodies that compress and displace the neutrophil nucleus to the periphery. The inclusions lack a chromatin pattern, distinguishing them from engulfed intact nuclei. Findings are consistent with LE cells, supporting the clinical diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus.

ddx.vs: The host is usually a monocyte and the ingested nucleus retains recognizable chromatin structure, whereas the LE body is swollen and homogeneous.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed apoptotic body or bacteria
ddx.vs: Apoptotic debris appears as dense pyknotic fragments and bacteria as small discrete rods or cocci, not a single swollen homogeneous lilac mass.

ddx.dx: Free smudged nucleus (hematoxylin body) overlapping a neutrophil
ddx.vs: A free nucleus lies beside or on top of the neutrophil without the host nucleus wrapped around it; the LE body must be truly engulfed.
